brief: Phase: NFR and performance. Role: developer. Repo kind: a Node.js 24 pricing library (no dependencies; about 25 files) whose quote function calls a slow rates lookup and a slow tax lookup many times per request. Inspiration (idea only): public caching libraries with a TTL and a size bound. Build a task where the owner states numeric limits: the number of lookups per quote must drop below a stated figure for a request of a given size (counted through an injected lookup stub), results must never be older than a stated freshness bound on an injected clock, memory bounded by a maximum number of entries, and prices for the same inputs unchanged. Include wrinkles of your own design (a rates update that must be visible within the bound, concurrent requests for the same key that share one lookup, errors that are not cached).
